title: SemanticIntentPrototypesPolicy
description: Declarative semantic vector prototypes for intent and sub-intent routing in FastEmbedSemanticRouter.
disclaimer_prototype: Refusals, AI capability disclaimers, cannot access bank statements, not privy to financial data, unable to check records, do not have access to accounts, language model limitations.

intent_prototypes.CASH_DIAGNOSTIC: Inquiries evaluating business cash flow, cash runway duration in days, how many days left, days of cash remaining, daily net burn rate, bank account balance, projected cash deficits, working capital risk, cash conversion cycle, customer DSO payment terms, supplier DPO terms, operating in the red, customer concentration risk, client revenue concentration, break-even sales, insolvency risk, bouncing payroll, running out of money, bleeding cash, and liquidity health from bank statements.
intent_prototypes.CREDIT_UNDERWRITING: Inquiries regarding borrowing business money, credit line qualification, merchant invoice factoring, commercial loan options, pre-qualified financing options, loan eligibility, borrowing capacity, debt facilities, options, and truth-in-lending APR interest rates.
intent_prototypes.ACTION_STAGING: Requests to stage, commit, authorize, draw down funds from an approved credit facility, transfer money, execute loan agreements, or pledge customer invoices into the staging ledger.
intent_prototypes.GENERAL_ASSISTANCE: Conversational greetings, introductions, hello, hi, hey, who are you, how can you assist our business, how do you help my company, what can you do, explaining assistant capabilities, onboarding guides, general financial concepts, business definitions, corporate finance terminology, accounting formulas, business formulas, metrics explanations, financial education, financial literacy questions, what is my financial status, general business financial status overview without statements, walkthrough, or general system help.
intent_prototypes.OFF_TOPIC: Inquiries regarding humor, comedy, funny jokes, riddles, poetry, creative writing, cooking recipes, food ingredients, sports matches, athletes, movies, entertainment, video games, gardening, household repairs, plumbing, romantic advice, general science, quantum physics, astrology, weather forecasts, geography, countries, capital cities, world history, ancient civilizations, wars, philosophy, software engineering, coding, programming, computer code, writing python scripts, algorithms, or non-business trivia.

sub_intent_prototypes.DEFICIT: Projected cash shortfall, upcoming cash deficit, running out of money, bouncing payroll, overdraft date, overdraft risk, insolvency warning.
sub_intent_prototypes.RUNWAY: Cash runway duration in days, how many days left to survive, time until cash runs out.
sub_intent_prototypes.BURN: Average daily cash burn, spending velocity, daily outflows, operational expense drain rate.
sub_intent_prototypes.BALANCE: Current available bank cash balance, closing balance, available funds in bank account.
sub_intent_prototypes.ADVICE: Strategic CFO recommendations, advice on improving cash flow, how to extend runway.
sub_intent_prototypes.CONCENTRATION: Client revenue concentration, top customer share, HHI index, customer dependency risk.
sub_intent_prototypes.BREAK_EVEN: Calculate break-even sales, break-even revenue, contribution margin, fixed costs, margin of safety.
sub_intent_prototypes.AMORTIZATION: Calculate monthly loan payment, loan amortization schedule, calculate loan installment and annual interest rate percentage, commercial loan interest.
sub_intent_prototypes.DSCR: Calculate debt service coverage ratio, calculate DSCR, net operating income to debt service.
sub_intent_prototypes.FACTORING: Calculate invoice factoring advance, calculate factoring discount fee, net invoice proceeds, factor rate APR.
sub_intent_prototypes.DEFENSIVE_INTERVAL: Calculate defensive interval ratio, DIR days, quick assets covering daily operational expenses.
sub_intent_prototypes.OPTIONS: Pre-qualified financing options, what loans can we qualify for, borrowing eligibility, matched credit facilities, credit line limits.
sub_intent_prototypes.WORKING_CAPITAL: Working capital risk, cash conversion cycle, customer DSO payment terms, supplier DPO payment terms, trade terms, receivables terms.
sub_intent_prototypes.FCCR: Calculate fixed charge coverage ratio, FCCR, EBITDA and lease charges coverage.
sub_intent_prototypes.DEBT_CAPACITY: Calculate maximum prudent debt capacity, maximum borrowing capacity based on cash flow and DAB, safe leverage limit.
sub_intent_prototypes.WCR: Calculate working capital requirement, WCR, operating working capital needed, receivables and inventory minus payables.
sub_intent_prototypes.OCF_RATIO: Calculate operating cash flow ratio, operating cash flow to current liabilities, short-term debt coverage.
sub_intent_prototypes.BREAK_EVEN_UNITS: Calculate break-even units, break-even sales volume, how many units must we sell to break even.
sub_intent_prototypes.ATTRITION: Calculate customer churn impact, lost client impact on burn rate and cash runway, revenue attrition.
sub_intent_prototypes.INVOICE_HASH: Verify invoice hash, check invoice double financing, check blockchain invoice integrity, consortium registry check.
sub_intent_prototypes.CURRENT_RATIO: Calculate current ratio, short-term liquidity ratio, current assets divided by current liabilities, working capital balance sheet health.
sub_intent_prototypes.QUICK_RATIO: Calculate quick ratio, acid-test ratio, liquid quick assets excluding inventory over current liabilities, immediate liquidity.
sub_intent_prototypes.DEBT_TO_EQUITY: Calculate debt to equity ratio, D/E ratio, total debt divided by shareholder equity, financial leverage, capital structure solvency.
sub_intent_prototypes.INTEREST_COVERAGE: Calculate interest coverage ratio, times interest earned TIE, EBIT divided by interest expense, debt covenant coverage.
sub_intent_prototypes.TRADE_CREDIT: Evaluate supplier vendor trade credit terms, early payment discount, 2/10 net 30 implied APR, prompt payment discount, stretching trade payables.
sub_intent_prototypes.CASH_DRAG: Calculate treasury cash drag, idle cash yield loss, opportunity cost of excess cash balance in checking vs money market sweep yield APY.
sub_intent_prototypes.DUPONT_ROE: Calculate 3-stage DuPont analysis, Return on Equity ROE decomposition, net profit margin, asset turnover, equity multiplier.
sub_intent_prototypes.LEASE_VS_BUY: Evaluate equipment lease vs buy NPV, commercial lease or buy comparison, equipment financing, purchase vs lease after-tax cost.
sub_intent_prototypes.ALTMAN_Z_SCORE: Calculate Altman Z-score, Altman Z prime score, private SME bankruptcy risk, financial distress score, credit insolvency risk.
sub_intent_prototypes.NET_DEBT_TO_EBITDA: Calculate net debt to EBITDA leverage ratio, debt to EBITDA multiple, leverage covenant, total debt minus cash divided by EBITDA.
sub_intent_prototypes.DEBT_SERVICE_BURDEN: Calculate debt service burden, debt burden ratio, annual debt payments as percentage of gross revenue, debt load.
sub_intent_prototypes.WACC: Calculate weighted average cost of capital WACC, blended cost of capital, cost of equity and after-tax cost of debt, hurdle rate.
sub_intent_prototypes.ENTERPRISE_VALUE: Calculate enterprise value EV, EV to EBITDA multiple, EV to revenue multiple, market equity plus net debt, takeover valuation.
sub_intent_prototypes.DCF_VALUATION: Calculate discounted cash flow DCF valuation, intrinsic enterprise value, discount future cash flows at WACC, perpetual growth terminal value.
sub_intent_prototypes.FCFF: Calculate free cash flow to firm FCFF, free cash flow to equity FCFE, operating cash flow minus capital expenditures CapEx, self-funding cash flow.
sub_intent_prototypes.ROIC: Calculate return on invested capital ROIC, capital efficiency, NOPAT divided by invested capital, operating return on capital.
sub_intent_prototypes.ROA: Calculate return on assets ROA, asset productivity, net income divided by total balance sheet assets, asset earnings efficiency.
sub_intent_prototypes.EVA: Calculate economic value added EVA, economic profit, NOPAT minus capital charge, surplus value created above WACC hurdle.
sub_intent_prototypes.LTV_CAC: Calculate customer lifetime value LTV, LTV to CAC ratio, customer acquisition cost payback, subscription unit economics, churn rate.
sub_intent_prototypes.CAC_PAYBACK: Calculate CAC payback period in months, months to recover customer acquisition cost, gross margin payback velocity.
sub_intent_prototypes.NRR: Calculate net revenue retention NRR, gross revenue retention GRR, ARR MRR cohort retention, customer expansion and churn rate.
sub_intent_prototypes.CURRENCY_CONVERSION: Convert currency, convert USD to EUR, exchange rate, convert money between currencies, currency conversion, FX spot rate, convert dollars to euros pounds yen taka, what is 50000 in eur.
sub_intent_prototypes.FX_EXPOSURE: Foreign exchange exposure, FX exposure, currency risk, net open position, foreign receivables and payables, FX volatility shock, currency fluctuation risk.
sub_intent_prototypes.GENERAL: General overview of financial health, business concepts, definitions, corporate finance formulas, accounting formulas, metrics explanations, and general financial education.
